prompt: Hibernate XML mapping node attribute dot period format
answer:
The Hibernate XML mapping `node` attribute accepts these formats:

- `"element-name"` — maps to the named XML element
- `"@attribute-name"` — maps to the named XML attribute
- `"."` — maps to the parent element
- `"element-name/@attribute-name"` — maps to the named attribute of the named element

Thus, a dot (`.`) maps the property or entity data to its parent XML element.
